notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 97–429, § 2, Jan. 8, 1983, 96 Stat. 2269, which set out Congressional findings and declaration of policy, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 97–429, § 1, Jan. 8, 1983, 96 Stat. 2269, provided that Pub. L. 97–429, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Texas Band of Kickapoo Act”.
